mapper.select: SELECT t.project_id AS "projectId", pos.category AS "category", SUM(t.cost) AS "amount" FROM pm_timesheet t LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.user_id = t.user_id AND e.status <> 'LEFT' LEFT JOIN hr_position pos ON pos.id = e.position_id WHERE t.status = 'APPROVED' AND t.voucher_id IS NULL AND t.work_date >= #{begin} AND t.work_date <= #{end} GROUP BY t.project_id, pos.category HAVING SUM(t.cost) <> 0

SELECT project_id AS "projectId", SUM(amount) AS "amount" FROM pm_cost WHERE source = 'MANUAL' AND status = 'APPROVED' AND voucher_id IS NULL AND cost_date >= #{begin} AND cost_date <= #{end} GROUP BY project_id HAVING SUM(amount) <> 0

SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.code AS "code", p.customer_id AS "customerId", p.contract_amount AS "contractAmount", p.tax_rate AS "taxRate", p.progress AS "progress", p.status AS "status", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.cost) FROM pm_timesheet t WHERE t.project_id = p.id AND t.status = 'APPROVED' AND t.work_date <= #{end}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM pm_cost c WHERE c.project_id = p.id AND c.status = 'APPROVED' AND c.cost_date <= #{end}), 0) AS "cumCost", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.revenue) FROM pm_revenue r WHERE r.project_id = p.id), 0) AS "recognizedRevenue", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.cost) FROM pm_revenue r WHERE r.project_id = p.id), 0) AS "recognizedCost" FROM pm_project p WHERE p.contract_amount > 0 AND p.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'FINISHED', 'CLOSED')
SELECT r.*, v.voucher_no FROM pm_revenue r LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = r.voucher_id WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY r.period, r.id
